name: Teff
siboNotes: Teff is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally gluten-free and low FODMAP. Its small grain size makes it easier to digest than larger grains.
preparationTips: Rinse teff before cooking to remove any debris
Use a 3:1 water-to-teff ratio when cooking
Toast teff in a dry pan before cooking for enhanced nutty flavor
Cook for 15-20 minutes until tender and porridge-like
pairsWellWith: Low FODMAP vegetables like carrots and spinach
Fresh herbs like parsley and chives
Low FODMAP proteins like chicken or fish
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein (complete amino acid profile)
